data.text:
Ahammed Naseef vs State Of Kerala on 7 June, 2024 
Author: Bechu Kurian Thomas
Bench: Bechu Kurian Thomas
 In The High Court Of Kerala At Ernakulam
 Present
 The Honourable Mr. Justice Bechu Kurian Thomas
 Friday, the 7th day of June 2024 / 17th Jyaishta, 1946
 Crl.M.Appl.No.1/2024 In Crl.Mc No. 4916 Of 2024
 Cc 397/2022 Of Judicial Magistrate Of First Class, Perambra
Petitioner(S)/Accused Nos. 3 To 9:
 1. Ahammed Naseef, Aged 35 Years, S/O Soopy, Kaniyaram Kandam (H),
 Puthur P.O., Omassery, Kozhikode District, Pin - 673582
 2. Marakombath Muhammed, Aged 61 Years, S/O Seethi, Marakombath (H),
 Edacheri P.O.,Kozhikode District, Pin - 673502
 3. Shaheer C, Aged 35 Years, S/O Ammed Haji, Chalil (H), Kakannur,
 Edacheri, Vatakara, Kozhikode District, Pin - 673502 
 4. Shabeer M.M, Aged 33 Years, S/O Abdul Kadar, Safa (H), Peringathur,
 Thalassery, Kannur District, Pin - 670675
 5. Usman Tharayintavida, Aged 62 Years, S/O Ammad, Thattante Parambath
 (H), Edacheri, Vatakara, Kozhikode District, Pin - 673502
 6. Shaheera, Aged 34 Years, D/O Ammed Haji, Kuniyil (H), Prakkadav,
 Puliyayi, Chekkiad, Kozhikode District, Pin - 673509
 7.  KUNHALU UMMAR MOHAMMED, AGED 61 YEARS, S/O UMMAR MOHAMMED, BAITHUL  BARKA (H), PERINGATHUR P.O, KANNUR DISTRICT, PIN - 670675 RESPONDENT(S)/STATE AND COMPLAINANT:
 1. STATE OF KERALA, REPRESENTED BY PUBLIC PROSECUTOR,HIGH COURT OF  KERALA, PIN - 682031  2. FOOD SAFETY OFFICER, PERAMBRA CIRCLE, OFFICE OF THE FOOD SAFETY  OFFICER, MINI CIVIL STATION, PERAMBRA, PIN - 673525  Application praying that in the circumstances stated in the affidavit filed therewith the High Court be pleased to stay all further proceedings as against the Petitioners in C.C. 397/22 before the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-I, Perambra, in the interest of Justice. 
 This Application coming on for orders upon perusing the application and upon hearing the arguments of M/S. ADITHYA RAJEEV, S.PARVATHI & SAFA NAVAS, Advocates for the petitioners and PUBLIC PROSECUTOR for R1, the court passed the following:
 BECHU KURIAN THOMAS, J.
 =-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=
 Crl.M.A.No.1 of 2024  in Ahammed Naseef vs State Of Kerala on 7 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/31656361/
1  Crl.M.C.No.4916 of 2024  =-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=
 Dated this the 7th day of June, 2024  ORDER In the meantime, there will be a stay of further proceedings in C.C.No.397 of 2022 on the files of the Judicial First Class Magistrate's Court, Perambra, as against the petitioners alone, for a period of six months. 
Sd/-
BECHU KURIAN THOMAS, JUDGE RKM Ahammed Naseef vs State Of Kerala on 7 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/31656361/
